relationships.evidence_quote: Knockdown of HDAC9 significantly increased RUNX3 acetylation in NP cells

relationships.subject: HDAC9
relationships.evidence_quote: HDAC9 knockdown significantly inhibited cell viability and promoted cell apoptosis

relationships.subject: HDAC9
relationships.evidence_quote: HDAC9KO mice exhibited more severe degenerative changes of IVDs in the structure, signal intensity, and boundary between NP and AF than WT mice at 6 months of age

key_findings: HDAC9 is decreased in degenerated NP and its deletion accelerates age-related IVDD in mice.
HDAC9 deacetylates and stabilizes RUNX3 (reducing ubiquitin-proteasomal degradation); RUNX3 silencing reverses effects of HDAC9 knockdown.
